what: Buffers a jump press for jumpBufferMs and consumes it on the next ground contact, and also allows a jump within coyoteTimeMs of leaving the ground.
why: The press was latched for one FixedUpdate and discarded if the capsule was not grounded in that step, so presses during the landing frames vanished.

what: New serialized field, default 120 ms, the window a jump press stays live for.
why: Tunable in the inspector without a rebuild. 120 is a guess copied from the feel of other platformers, not measured against this capsule.

what: The two new timing fields that together decide whether a press becomes a jump: how long a press is held, and how long after leaving the ground a jump is still allowed.
why: Buffering alone still dropped presses made one or two frames after the capsule left a ledge, so the same change added a grace period on the other side.

what: Reads the movement axes every frame and latches a jump press into jumpPressedThisFrame, which HandleJump clears when it consumes the press.
why: Input has to be sampled in Update because GetButtonDown is only true for the frame of the press and FixedUpdate can skip a frame entirely.
